skill.displayName: 低值易耗品与周转材料摊销核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The skill’s local ledger-checking code appears contained, but its instructions contradict the no-payment/no-network description by adding a paid purchase and installation flow.

dimensions.detail: The executable code uses Node standard libraries, reads a user-provided input file, runs local checks, and reports network_used false. Read and Bash access are proportionate for the local checker, but not for undisclosed commerce handling if an agent follows the purchase instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, dependency download, remote payload, or package manager action is present in the inspected artifact. The concern is instructional: the skill tells the agent to complete paid fulfillment installation, but the referenced official purchase instructions are not included in the package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The description says no payment and no network, while later runtime instructions require presenting an upsell and, if selected, using official purchase instructions to obtain an order and payment link. That contradiction is under-disclosed for users installing a free local accounting checker.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected scripts do not write files, create persistence, modify tools, store credentials, or alter system configuration. No credential or session-store access was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability is a deterministic local check for low-value consumables ledgers, and the shipped scripts align with that purpose; however, SKILL.md also instructs the agent to complete a paid upgrade flow, relay payment links or QR codes, and install fulfillment after payment, which materially expands the skill beyond reconciliation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a Chinese-language local ledger checker that also embeds paid-upgrade instructions. Treat any payment link, QR code, or installation step as outside the free local checker, verify it through the platform’s official billing flow, and consider setting SKILL_NO_UPSELL=1 if you use it only for local checks.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in part: SKILL.md makes local/no-payment/no-network claims while later instructing a paid upgrade flow with payment link or QR relay. The shipped code itself remains local.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present in the workspace and was fully inspected; it imports the local engine and does not retrieve remote code.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: the free local checker includes mandatory post-result upgrade messaging and a path to paid purchase handling, which is not clearly declared in the manifest description.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Accepted for the forced upsell instructions because they require the agent to present free versus paid options on each skill use unless disabled. The Chinese-language UI is noted but less material because the skill’s accounting domain and metadata are already Chinese-language focused.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: order handling, payment-link delivery, and post-payment installation are not necessary for the stated reconciliation function and create a trust-boundary expansion.
